intended_object: The total (degree −1) linear map ⨁ₙ K.X n → ⨁ₙ L.X n induced by a homotopy H between cochain maps f, g of ℕ-indexed cochain complexes of R-modules, sending the degree-(n+1) summand to the degree-n summand via H.hom (n+1) n (inferred from docstring and module doc).
explanation: For ℕ-indexed cochain complexes, H.hom i j can only be nonzero when j + 1 = i, so the nontrivial components are exactly H.hom (n+1) n. The definition assembles these with DirectSum.toModule, follows each with the inclusion DirectSum.lof into summand n, and sets the map to zero on the degree-0 summand, where there is no lower degree to land in. This matches the docstring. The file also proves the homotopy identity d∘h + h∘d = f − g on the total modules and that the map is homogeneous of degree −1, which confirms the definition is right. The setting (any ring R, ℕ-indexed complexes in ModuleCat R) is the library's deliberate choice for nonnegative complexes, and the degree-0 case depends on it. Mathlib has no total-module construction for complexes or homotopies, so there is no more general Mathlib version it should have used.
